title: THE FOG BANKS ARE BAKED
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 9, atmosphere) and his answer 21 b (60 fps on a mid laptop at 1080p). The seven slow fog banks that drift across a fog raid each built a fresh soft gradient every single frame and filled a square up to 1,340 pixels across with it. The shape never changes, so it is now painted once into one picture and each bank is that picture drawn at the same place, size and strength. The fog looks the same and costs less every frame. The graphics rollback switch keeps the old way.
now: Fog banks draw from one baked picture, the same fog for less work.
